values.en: The chain rule gives $\dot\gamma=X_u\dot u+X_v\dot v$ and $\ddot\gamma=X_{uu}\dot u^2+2X_{uv}\dot u\dot v+X_{vv}\dot v^2+X_u\ddot u+X_v\ddot v$, all at $\alpha(t)$. Pairing with the unit normal kills the last two terms and leaves $e\dot u^2+2f\dot u\dot v+g\dot v^2=\mathrm{II}(\dot\gamma,\dot\gamma)$. No division by speed occurs.
values.zh-CN: 链式法则给出 $\dot\gamma=X_u\dot u+X_v\dot v$ 及 $\ddot\gamma=X_{uu}\dot u^2+2X_{uv}\dot u\dot v+X_{vv}\dot v^2+X_u\ddot u+X_v\ddot v$，各偏导均在 $\alpha(t)$ 处取值。与单位法向作内积后末两项为零，剩下 $e\dot u^2+2f\dot u\dot v+g\dot v^2=\mathrm{II}(\dot\gamma,\dot\gamma)$。全程不除以速度。
